description: W3C DID Core test suite used by scripts/did-core-test-suite/run.js (WP-7). Pinned deliberately; update with a reason, never to make a run pass.

notApplicable.suites/did-resolution: Needs DID resolution results (didResolutionMetadata from a DID resolver). The SDKs return documents, not DID Resolution results.
notApplicable.suites/did-url-dereferencing: Needs a DID URL dereferencer. The SDKs do not implement DID URL dereferencing.
notApplicable.suites/did-consumption: Checks consumer cases that an implementation reports (a representation and what its consumer parsed from it). The SDKs are only run here as producers. Not in the suite's own suite-config.js at this commit.
